title: Code for Hygienic Practices for Processing and Handling of Dehydrated Fruits and Vegetables Including Edible Fungi
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This Code of hygienic practices applies to fruits and vegetables which are artificially dehydrated (including freeze-dried), either from the succulent stage or in combination with sun-drying, and covers the products commonly associated with the phrase 'dehydrated food'.
clause_3_terminology: Code for Hygienic Practices for Processing and Handling of Dehydrated Fruits and Vegetables Including Edible Fungi

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
